item.title: IIIF configuration
item.author: mail@christianmahnke.de (Christian Mahnke)
item.description:
Site configuration

All IIIF related settings live in [params.iiif]:

[params.iiif]
  # Presentation API version used for manifests: 3 (default) or 4 (draft)
  # Can be overridden per page, see 'Presentation 4'
  presentationVersion = 3

  # JS asset for the Presentation API viewer, default: 'ts/iiif/tify.ts' (TIFY)
  presentationViewer = "ts/iiif/tify.ts"

  # JS asset for the Image API viewer, default: 'ts/iiif-image-viewer.ts' (OpenLayers)
  imageViewer = "ts/iiif-image-viewer.ts"

item.title: IIIF page metadata
item.author: mail@christianmahnke.de (Christian Mahnke)
item.description:
Page metadata

Manifest generation is opt-in per page and driven by front matter.

Enabling manifests

---
title: Example
outputs: [html, iiif-manifest]
---

Pages without an explicit outputs entry are collected into collections only if the site config defines them, see Configuration.

Manifest properties (iiif. namespace)

Key Type Purpose
iiif.presentationVersion int 3 (default) or 4 (draft), see Presentation 4
iiif.behavior string Manifest behavior, e.g. paged (default), continuous, individuals
iiif.metadata list Descriptive metadata labels/values as JSON list
iiif.structure list Logical structure (ranges) from label/page/end/items entries — range and canvas IDs are generated at build time, see Structure
iiif.rights string Rights statement URL
iiif.logo.img string Logo image URL
iiif.logo.url string IIIF Image API service endpoint for the logo
iiif.context string Marks the page as IIIF content, e.g. http://iiif.io/api/presentation/3/context.json — enables the viewer in <head> and the page body
iiif.manifest string Manifest URL used by the embedded viewer (defaults to the page’s manifest.json)
iiifclass string Additional CSS class for the iiif content wrapper
subtype string Additional CSS class for the iiif content wrapper
preview string Resource name used for manifest/collection thumbnails (falls back to resources named preview, cover, front, then the first resource)
linkedart any If present, adds a seeAlso link to the page’s linkedart output format

Legacy keys (iiifMetadata, iiifStructure) are no longer read and no longer abort the build — migrate to iiif.metadata / iiif.structure.

item.title: Presentation 3
item.author: mail@christianmahnke.de (Christian Mahnke)
item.description:
Presentation API 3

This page generates a Presentation API 3 manifest from its page resources, see Page metadata. The manifest is available as manifest.json. The iiif.structure front matter adds a logical structure (the structures in the manifest) with range and canvas identifiers generated at build time, see Structure.

item.title: Presentation 3 Structure Nesting
item.author: mail@christianmahnke.de (Christian Mahnke)
item.description:
Presentation API 3 Structure Nesting

Regression fixture for nested iiif.structure entries: the output follows IIIF Cookbook recipe 0024 (“Table of Contents for Book Chapters”) — a single, always-present root range labeled through the iiifTableOfContents i18n key holds the top-level ranges; ranges with sub-ranges list only those sub-ranges, leaf ranges list all canvases of their span, and no first/last canvas markers are emitted. Covers chapter nodes with page and sub-sections, a grouping node without page, and end spans. On Tify ≤ 0.36.2 the previous/next-section pagination and the Info view’s current-chapter display stay inactive for such manifests until Tify implements descending span detection (the “dig deeper” TODO in its store). The manifest is available as manifest.json.

item.title: Presentation 4 (draft)
item.author: mail@christianmahnke.de (Christian Mahnke)
item.description:
Presentation API 4 draft

The theme supports generating Presentation API 4 (version 4.0.0-draft) manifests. The draft is structurally compatible with API 3 — the templates in layouts/partials/iiif/3/ are the single implementation, layouts/partials/iiif/4/manifest.json only delegates and layouts/partials/iiif/4/scene.json is the version specific override building the 3D Scene containers (see Page metadata). The same applies to the leaflet layout: layouts/partials/iiif/4/manifest-leaflet.json delegates to the shared API 3 implementation, see Page metadata.
